description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle, notification, web, websocket, security, and authentication interfaces. It declares classes, structs, and methods that facilitate plugin management, communication, and security features.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifecycle management, including initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting communication channels.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with notification registration.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security checks and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Notification callback when a plugin changes state to activated.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Notification callback when a plugin changes state to deactivated.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Notification callback when a plugin becomes unavailable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification with the composite plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification from the composite plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON elements over WebSocket.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming text socket messages.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles raw data inbound on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data outbound on a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade is allowed.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a request is allowed.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a JSONRPC message is allowed.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Retrieves the security token payload.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves the security officer for a given token.
